opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, enrolled on an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish higher education institution, and not eligible for government funding for their tuition fees. Must be entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, have Limited Leave to Remain valid for the course, or be an asylum seeker.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to cover the cost of tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for undergraduate students from low-income households in Scotland who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government, including those who withdrew from study previously and asylum seekers.
